question: A dishonest dealer professes to sell goods at the cost price, but uses a false weight of 900 grams instead of a kg. His gain percentage is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Gain %** = [Error ÷ (True Value − Error)] × 100

Here, **True Value** = 1000 g and **Error** = 1000 − 900 = 100 g.

Gain % = [100 ÷ (1000 − 100)] × 100 = (100 ÷ 900) × 100

Gain % = 100 ÷ 9 = 11 1/9 %

**∴ The correct answer is 11 1/9 %.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**True Weight** = 1 kg = 1000 g

**False Weight** used by dealer = 900 g

**Selling Price (SP)** = Cost Price (CP) of 1000 g

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/440d052ed517854e05f9150036b6d9ee755e8b3e960aba1a8b200d99a1a99eac.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Profit % = (Profit ÷ Cost Price) × 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **Cost Price (CP)** of 1 g of goods be ₹1.

⇒ CP of 1000 g (True weight) = ₹1000.

⇒ The dealer sells 900 g for the price of 1000 g.

⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** of 900 g = ₹1000.

⇒ **Actual CP** of 900 g for the dealer = ₹900.

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = ₹1000 − ₹900 = ₹100.

⇒ Profit % = (100 ÷ 900) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 100 ÷ 9 = 11 1/9 %

**∴ The correct answer is 11 1/9 %.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Concept

When a dealer sells at **Cost Price** but uses a **False Weight** (Wf) instead of **True Weight** (Wₜ), the profit percentage is calculated on the weight actually given.

Combined Profit Formula

If a dealer marks up price by x% and also uses y% less weight, the **Total Profit %** = [(100 + x) ÷ (100 − y) − 1] × 100.

Successive Discount and Cheating

If a dealer cheats while buying (takes more) and while selling (gives less), the net profit depends on the **Ratio of actual goods exchanged** to the **Price paid/received**.
